newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Vietnam in border trade bank clearance deal.
newsitem.headline: China, Vietnam in border trade bank clearance deal.

text.p: China and Vietnam have signed an agreement that would allow bank clearance of border trade transactions, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The agreement was signed between the Guangxi branch of the Agricultural Bank of China and the Guang Ninh provincial branch of the Agricultural Bank of Vietnam, Xinhua said.
It would be implemented on an experimental basis in Dongxing city in the southern region of Guangxi and the Vietnamese county of Hai Ninh, the agency said.
Guangxi's border trade totalled 12.4 billion yuan ($1.5 billion) between 1991 and 1995 and 2.6 billion yuan ($313 million) in 1995 alone, it said.
But outdated means of clearance -- cash and barter -- hampered the fledgling trade in the Sino-Vietnamese border area, the agency said.
